channel.description: Latest articles from Tuoi Tre News (tuoitrenews.vn)

item.title: Nipah virus fears trigger airport checks across Asia after India confirms two cases
item.description: NEW DELHI/BANGKOK/SINGAPORE -- Two cases of the deadly Nipah virus in India have prompted authorities in Thailand, Singapore, Hong Kong and Malaysia to step up airport screening in an effort to prevent the infection from spreading.

item.title: Real Madrid and PSG miss automatic qualification on frenetic group-stage finale
item.description: LONDON -- Real Madrid missed out on automatic qualification for the Champions League knockout rounds as they crumbled to a 4-2 defeat at Benfica on a frenetic final night of group-stage action across Europe on Wednesday.

item.title: Vietnam gold prices hit record $7,300 per tael as global bullion tops $5,600
item.description: Gold prices in Vietnam surged to a record high on Thursday, with SJC bullion rising to VND190.3 million (US$7,302) per tael after global gold briefly broke above $5,600 an ounce for the first time, driven by heightened geopolitical tensions and safe-haven demand.

item.title: When Vietnamese children go online every day, are parents truly present?
item.description: There was a time when many Vietnamese parents believed online safety was someone else’s problem, trusting that their well-behaved children were immune. Yet the moment such confidence takes hold is also when the protective line shielding children from fake news, harmful content and toxic information online becomes dangerously thin.

item.title: European Council president begins official visit to Vietnam
item.description: President of the European Council António Costa arrived in Hanoi on Wednesday evening, beginning his two-day official visit to Vietnam at the invitation of State President Luong Cuong.

item.title: Plane crash in Colombia kills 15, including politician
item.description: BOGOTA -- A plane crash in northeast Colombia on Wednesday killed all 15 people on board, including a local lawmaker, state-run airline Satena said.

item.title: Vietnam starts to launch time-limited visa exemption scheme for special foreigners
item.description: Permanent Deputy Prime Minister Nguyen Hoa Binh has signed Decision No. 161 approving a plan to implement a decree on time-limited visa exemptions for foreign nationals, classified as special beneficiaries serving the country's socio-economic growth.

item.title: Amazon axes 16,000 jobs as it pushes AI and efficiency
item.description: Amazon confirmed 16,000 corporate job cuts on Wednesday, completing a plan for around 30,000 since October, while leaving open the possibility of further reductions.

item.title: Nearly 4 tonnes of food products of unknown origin seized in Vietnam ahead of Tet
item.description: Police in Quang Ninh Province, northern Vietnam have discovered and confiscated nearly four metric tons of food products of unknown origin that were about to be released onto the market ahead of the Lunar New Year holiday, or Tet.

item.title: 'One Battle After Another' leads BAFTA nominations, 'Sinners' also recognised
item.description: LONDON - Action-packed dark comedy "One Battle After Another" led nominations for the BAFTA Film Awards on Tuesday, with vampire thriller and box office smash "Sinners" also widely recognised at Britain's top movie honours.
